decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Application Form, Design and Access Statement,  EX.01, 00028/1RevA, Received 5 August 2013 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The restaurant shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 7.00am to 11.00pm Monday to Saturday, and 10.00am to 10.00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays. No customers shall remain on the premises 30 minutes after this time.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 6 - The scheme approved under Condition 5 shall be fully implemented before the A3 use opens to customers.

Condition : 7 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 7 shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 10 - For noise emitted from fixed plant on the site the rating level shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997.
Condition : 11 - The ceiling/floor separation should comply with the minimum construction/insulation standards set out in the building regulations.
Condition : 12 - Refuse collections and deliveries should only be made between the hours of 7am-11pm Monday to Saturday and 9am-8pm on Sundays.

Condition : 13 - The rear door shall be fitted with a self closer and this shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order. The rear door shall remain closed except when opened to take refuse and recycling to the rear of the premises.
Condition : 14 - The area at the rear of the premises shall not be used for outdoor seating, dining or drinking.
description: Removal of condition 3 of permission 00248/114/P12 which states premises shall be used for a caf? and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3)
